correctness.rationale: The proposed density solves Dp-rp=0 within each gap, integrates to one and its derivative jumps exactly cancel reset-point delta fluxes; stationarity and irreducibility follow. Harmonic coordinate H on Voronoi cells has matching values and first derivatives at midpoints, H(x+L)-H(x)=L, and generator LH=0, giving bounded-corrector martingale and drift zero. Its continuous/jump quadratic variation integrates to E cosh^2=(T+2S)/(3T), E sinh^2=2(S/T-1)/3 and D_eff=rL^2/(4ST); bounded jump size and ergodicity give CLT. Taylor and max-gap estimates yield the stated low/high rate terms. Independent Gaussian/jump-bracket quadrature and numerical unequal-vs-equal reversal checks pass; these are corroboration, not a replacement for the all-gap analytic proof.
